details: Windows 1.0.66: a GMRS-provided CHIRP.csv failed with "no Frequency column (columns found: Location,Name,Frequency,...)". The columns are listed without spaces, so the whole header was one quoted cell: the file has each line wrapped in quotes (a spreadsheet that kept each line in column A). Decode now re-splits one-field rows.
summary: CSV with every line wrapped in quotes rejected as having no Frequency column
